board_notes.pico2-knob: Rev 2 (JLC Y4, ordered 2026-10-15). The board file is the uncommitted rev 2 copy from ice-cubed (~/newhome/softek/pico2-knob); its copper matches the fabbed gerbers.

figures.caption: SMA outline: the cathode band end

parts.note: SOT-23: the single leg on one side is D (3); G (1) and S (2) are on the other side. Rev 2 has S on +BATT and D on U2 Vin, so the rev 1 leg-swap bodge is not needed.
parts.warn: Fitted part is MMFTP3401 (from the rev 1 stock), not the DMG3415U in the schematic. It has the same SOT-23 pinout: 1 = G, 2 = S, 3 = D.

parts.note: Goes on the back, on female sockets, with USB-C facing the top rim (README).
0.5 mm pitch: the stencil has 0.20 mm apertures here (mechanical/stencil/README.md).
JST-PH LiPo packs don't share a polarity convention. Check the pack's red lead against BAT+ before plugging in.
Fitted from stock as 820 pF; the schematic says 800 pF (orders/README.md).
